title: Architecture
lead: One block is one Docker Compose. The face shows the name and the host-port range. Edges are labeled with the dial port. Hover a block or a line for the detail.
hint: Dev comes first. Secure follows the slash. The same port on two NAS machines does not collide, because the IP differs.
gridLead: One block per repo, padded to a port ending in 9. Solid is used, hatched is reserved.
clickHint: Hover for detail, click to pin.

internet.title: Internet
internet.body: The public network only sees the router.

router.title: Router
router.body: Forwards only 80 and 443 to the NAS that runs Traefik.

traefik.title: NFX-Edge Traefik
traefik.body: File routes in dynamic/*.project.yml. No Docker network. 80/443 stays out of the 10000 blocks.

identity.title: NFX-Identity
identity.body: Login and profiles. auth, asset, and the console.

news.title: NFX-News
news.body: source, news, crawl, report, notify, mcp. Dials Identity auth gRPC.

storages.title: NFX-Storages
storages.body: Order: s3, admin, object, iam, notify. S3 is a Host route.

edge.title: NFX-Edge sites
edge.body: sites-base owns certificates. ACME still uses Traefik on port 80.

aquaworks.title: AquaWorks
aquaworks.body: Static site. The LAN path redirects to this port.

timetable.title: TimetableCraft
timetable.body: Static site. The LAN path redirects to this port.

stack.title: NFX-Stack
stack.body: Shared data plane. Products dial the NAS IP plus these ports. No shared network.
stack.listen: each service keeps its own container port

nas2.title: NAS2
nas2.body: The same Compose files and port numbers. Traefik only swaps the IP in the URL.
